signals.title: Google DeepMind releases Veo 3 with native audio and speech synthesis
signals.summary: Veo 3 generates synchronised audio, ambient sound, and speech directly alongside video, marking a step toward fully multimodal AI media generation. Released via Google Vertex AI and integrated into Gemini products.

signals.title: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 4 with extended thinking and agentic capabilities
signals.summary: Claude Opus 4 introduces extended thinking traces, improved multi-step reasoning, and native tool use for autonomous agent workflows. Positioned as the highest-capability model in the Claude 4 family.

signals.title: Mistral AI raises €600M Series B to accelerate open model development
signals.summary: French AI lab Mistral closes a €600M funding round led by General Catalyst, placing the company's valuation above €6B. The round funds expansion of the Le Chat assistant and continued open-weight model releases.

signals.title: Mamba-2: Structured state space models at transformer parity for long sequences
signals.summary: This paper introduces structured state space models achieving competitive performance to transformers on language tasks while scaling linearly with sequence length. Demonstrates particular advantages for sequences exceeding 64K tokens.

signals.title: Sakana AI publishes EvoTransformer: evolutionary architecture search for efficient transformers
signals.summary: Tokyo-based Sakana AI demonstrates an evolutionary algorithm that discovers more efficient transformer architectures without human-designed search spaces, reducing inference compute by up to 30% for equivalent benchmark performance.

signals.title: Cohere releases Command R+ for enterprise retrieval-augmented generation
signals.summary: Cohere launches Command R+, optimised for RAG pipelines in enterprise deployments. The model supports 128K context, 10 languages, and tool-calling chains out of the box, competing with GPT-4 on domain-specific business tasks without cloud vendor lock-in.

signals.title: xAI releases Grok 3 with deep research mode and 1M context window
signals.summary: Grok 3, trained on xAI's 100,000-GPU Colossus cluster, introduces a deep research mode that autonomously browses the web and synthesises reports. The model posts top benchmark scores on MATH, GPQA, and LLM-as-judge evaluations across major leaderboards.

signals.title: Baidu releases ERNIE 5 with multilingual scientific reasoning capabilities
signals.summary: ERNIE 5 achieves parity with GPT-4-class models on Chinese legal, scientific, and technical benchmarks, with significantly lower latency for Chinese-character token inference. Deployed across Baidu Search, Wenxin Yiyan, and Baidu Cloud API.

signals.title: AI21 Labs releases Jamba: first production SSM-transformer hybrid with MoE
signals.summary: Jamba combines Mamba state-space layers with transformer attention blocks and mixture-of-experts routing, delivering a 256K context window at a fraction of the memory footprint of comparable dense models. AI21 releases Jamba under Apache 2.0.

signals.title: Meta releases ARIA Gen 2 research glasses with on-device spatial AI
signals.summary: The second generation of Meta's ARIA research platform adds on-device neural inference, 200Hz eye-tracking, and an updated spatial audio array. Released to expanded academic research partners for spatial computing studies.

signals.title: Varjo XR-5 ships to industrial customers with 70 PPD visual resolution
signals.summary: Varjo's XR-5 headset achieves 70 pixels-per-degree in the central foveal region, matching human visual acuity in the field of view most used for precision work. Deployed by Airbus, Volkswagen, and L3Harris for simulation and design review.

signals.title: Cambridge study: spatial interfaces reduce cognitive load by 34% in procedural tasks
signals.summary: University of Cambridge researchers demonstrate that 3D spatial interfaces in AR reduce working memory demands compared to 2D screen-based equivalents for sequential procedural tasks, with measurable improvements in error rate and completion time.

signals.title: Sony launches SRD-XR1 spatial reality display for professional content creation
signals.summary: Sony's SRD-XR1 lenticular display creates glasses-free 3D viewing for a single user by tracking eye position at 1,000 Hz and rendering perspective in real time. Aimed at artists, automotive designers, and 3D content creators working at professional workstations.

signals.title: Siemens launches Industrial Metaverse Core for real-time digital twin collaboration
signals.summary: Siemens launches Industrial Metaverse Core at Hannover Messe, enabling multi-site engineering teams to collaborate in a physics-accurate digital twin of factory floor layouts and equipment. Partners include NVIDIA Omniverse and Microsoft Azure.

signals.title: Physical Intelligence publishes π0.2: generalist robot policy for dexterous manipulation
signals.summary: π0.2 demonstrates a single robot policy transferring across manipulation tasks — folding laundry, preparing food, assembling parts — with minimal per-task fine-tuning. The approach uses flow matching over diffusion policies.

signals.title: Figure AI raises $675M Series B led by Microsoft, NVIDIA, and OpenAI
signals.summary: Humanoid robotics company Figure AI closes a $675M Series B at a $2.6B valuation, accelerating deployment of Figure 02 in commercial manufacturing environments.

signals.title: Boston Dynamics retires hydraulic Atlas, introduces all-electric Atlas for automotive assembly
signals.summary: Boston Dynamics transitions Atlas to an all-electric platform, removing hydraulic systems entirely and partnering with Hyundai Motor Group for deployment in automotive production lines. The new design has greater range of motion than any previous Atlas iteration.

signals.title: NAVER LABS demonstrates multi-robot collaboration in ambient building management
signals.summary: NAVER LABS deploys a coordinated fleet of service robots across its 1784 headquarters, handling delivery, guidance, and cleaning tasks autonomously across 40 floors with no dedicated robot infrastructure modifications.

signals.title: Agility Robotics opens Congregation factory, first purpose-built humanoid production facility
signals.summary: Agility Robotics opens its Congregation facility in Salem, Oregon—the first factory purpose-built for humanoid robot production—targeting 10,000 Digit units per year. Amazon's fulfillment pilot expands alongside an emerging customer base in light manufacturing.

signals.title: Sanctuary AI ships Phoenix Gen 7 with Carbon general-purpose cognitive architecture
signals.summary: Sanctuary AI's seventh-generation Phoenix robot pairs with Carbon, a proprietary cognitive architecture trained on human task demonstrations. Initial deployments target retail and light manufacturing, with a claimed 3-hour new-task learning turnaround.

signals.title: KAIST HUBO demonstrates real-time dynamic obstacle avoidance in unstructured terrain
signals.summary: KAIST's HUBO humanoid robot achieves real-time dynamic obstacle avoidance using depth point cloud processing and model-predictive foot placement, allowing uninterrupted locomotion over rubble and collapsed floor sections. The work targets disaster response scenarios.

signals.title: Microsoft demonstrates topological qubit with Majorana 1 chip
signals.summary: Microsoft's Majorana 1 chip demonstrates a topological qubit architecture based on topoconductor materials, with claimed error rates orders of magnitude lower than superconducting qubits. Published in Nature with independent verification.

signals.title: IBM unveils 1,000-qubit Condor processor and Heron utility-scale chip
signals.summary: IBM's Condor becomes the first processor to break the 1,000-qubit barrier, while the smaller Heron processor demonstrates lower error rates on practical quantum circuits. IBM sets a target of 100,000 qubits by 2033.

signals.title: IQM Quantum Computers raises €150M to deploy on-premises quantum systems
signals.summary: Finnish quantum hardware company IQM closes a €150M funding round focused on delivering full-stack superconducting quantum systems directly to research institutions and enterprises, competing with IBM's cloud-first model.

signals.title: Quantinuum H2 sets world record on quantum volume and CLOPS benchmarks
signals.summary: Quantinuum's H2 trapped-ion processor achieves a quantum volume of 65,536 and posts circuit layer operations per second exceeding all other commercially available quantum hardware at the time. The system uses 56 fully-connected qubits with native mid-circuit measurement.

signals.title: Alice & Bob demonstrates cat qubit suppressing bit-flip errors by 10,000×
signals.summary: Paris-based Alice & Bob publishes hardware results showing their cat qubit architecture suppresses bit-flip errors by a factor of 10,000 versus phase-flip errors, enabling a resource-efficient pathway to fault tolerance. The approach could reduce physical-to-logical qubit overhead by 200×.

signals.title: PASQAL delivers 1,000-qubit neutral atom processor to European research consortium
signals.summary: PASQAL installs its first 1,000-qubit neutral atom quantum processor at a CEA facility under the EuroQCS programme. The system uses optical tweezers to trap rubidium atoms with individual addressing, targeting materials simulation and optimisation workloads.

signals.title: SpaceX Starship completes sixth integrated flight test with full booster catch
signals.summary: Starship IFT-6 successfully launches from Boca Chica, completes orbital velocity flight, and catches the Super Heavy booster with mechazilla arms for the second consecutive time. Ship re-enters and splashes down in the Indian Ocean on target.

signals.title: Rocket Lab announces dedicated Venus atmospheric mission for 2026
signals.summary: Rocket Lab's privately funded Venus mission will deploy an atmospheric probe aboard its Electron rocket, becoming the first private scientific mission to Venus. The probe aims to detect potential biosignatures in the temperate cloud deck.

signals.title: ESA's Hera spacecraft enters Didymos asteroid orbit, confirms DART impact crater
signals.summary: ESA's Hera mission arrives at the Didymos binary asteroid system and confirms the DART impact dramatically reshuffled Dimorphos's surface, leaving a 90-metre crater. Hera will map the system's mass distribution to validate planetary defence models.

signals.title: ISRO approves Chandrayaan-4 lunar sample return mission for 2028
signals.summary: India's space agency receives government approval for Chandrayaan-4, a two-launch lunar sample return mission targeting the south polar region. If successful, India would become the fourth nation to return lunar samples to Earth.

signals.title: Japan's H3 rocket completes second successful launch, validating commercial satellite capability
signals.summary: JAXA's H3 rocket successfully deploys the ALOS-4 Earth observation satellite after recovering from a maiden flight failure. The H3 is designed to halve launch costs versus H-IIA, restoring Japan's position as a competitive commercial launch provider.

signals.title: Astroscale ADRAS-J completes world-first rendezvous with uncooperative orbital debris
signals.summary: Astroscale's ADRAS-J spacecraft manoeuvres to within metres of a defunct JAXA H-2A rocket upper stage, collecting the first close-range inspection imagery of a non-cooperative tumbling object. The mission demonstrates proximity operations needed for future active debris removal.

signals.title: UAE Hope Probe completes primary science mission, releases full Martian atmospheric dataset
signals.summary: The Mohammed bin Rashid Space Centre's Hope Probe completes its primary mission around Mars, releasing a comprehensive atmospheric dataset to 200 research institutions worldwide. The mission marks the Arab world's first interplanetary science contribution.

signals.title: Axiom Space AX-4 delivers first commercial science crew to ISS
signals.summary: Axiom Space's fourth private astronaut mission to the International Space Station carries a 14-day science programme including a commercial pharmaceutical manufacturing experiment and the first Slovenian astronaut in space, demonstrating a repeatable private crew delivery model.

signals.title: SKA-Mid array reaches 50% construction milestone in Karoo Desert
signals.summary: The Square Kilometre Array Mid-Frequency telescope in South Africa passes 50% dish installation, with 74 of 197 antennas aligned and conducting early science observations of pulsar timing and HI galaxy surveys. First light on the full array is expected in 2028.

signals.title: Commonwealth Fusion begins SPARC tokamak construction after HTS magnet validation
signals.summary: Commonwealth Fusion Systems breaks ground on SPARC after its high-temperature superconducting magnet technology achieved 20 Tesla — strong enough to confine the plasma needed for net energy gain in a compact device. Full construction targets 2027 first plasma.

signals.title: Form Energy begins production of 100-hour iron-air batteries at West Virginia factory
signals.summary: Form Energy's first commercial factory begins producing iron-air batteries capable of 100 hours of continuous discharge, enabling multi-day storage that lithium-ion cannot economically provide. Technology uses iron pellets and oxygen, with no rare earth materials.

signals.title: Northvolt completes first phase of Europe's largest battery gigafactory in Skellefteå
signals.summary: Northvolt Ett reaches 16 GWh annual production capacity in its first phase, supplying Volkswagen, BMW, and Scania with lithium-ion cells manufactured using renewable energy. Phase 2 targets 60 GWh, making it Europe's largest single-site battery factory.

signals.title: Climeworks Mammoth plant reaches 36,000 tonnes per year CO₂ capture capacity
signals.summary: Climeworks' Mammoth facility in Iceland, the world's largest direct air capture plant at the time of opening, reaches its rated 36,000 tonne per year CO₂ removal capacity using geothermal energy. The plant costs approximately $1,000 per tonne with a roadmap to $300 by 2030.

signals.title: Eve Air Mobility eVTOL completes full-scale structural test campaign in Brazil
signals.summary: Eve Air Mobility, spun out from Embraer, completes destructive and fatigue structural tests on its four-seat eVTOL airframe, clearing the path for ANAC type certification in Brazil and an anticipated 2026 commercial service entry in São Paulo urban air mobility corridors.

signals.title: CSIRO and AGL commission grid-scale solar thermal storage in Hunter Valley
signals.summary: Australia's CSIRO and AGL commission a 30 MW solar thermal pilot with 14 hours of molten salt energy storage in the Hunter Valley, New South Wales. The project validates low-cost thermal storage paired with existing coal plant infrastructure at below AUD 100/MWh.

signals.title: KERI demonstrates seawater electrolysis system producing 10 kg/day green hydrogen
signals.summary: Korea Electrotechnology Research Institute engineers a membrane-electrode assembly tolerant of saline and chloride-rich seawater, producing green hydrogen at coastal sites without freshwater input. The pilot runs at 10 kg per day with 97% Faradaic efficiency in 3.5% salinity.

signals.title: MIT engineers metamaterial layer that eliminates crosstalk in photonic quantum chips
signals.summary: MIT researchers demonstrate a metamaterial electromagnetic shield that reduces photon crosstalk between adjacent waveguides in integrated photonic chips by 40 dB, a critical barrier to scaling photonic quantum processors beyond a few dozen qubits.

signals.title: Samsung Foundry achieves commercial yield on 2nm gate-all-around process node
signals.summary: Samsung Foundry announces volume production readiness of its 2nm GAA (gate-all-around) process, delivering a 25% reduction in power consumption versus 3nm at equivalent performance. Initial customers include mobile and data centre AI accelerator designs.

signals.title: ETH Zurich demonstrates sub-milliwatt neuromorphic chip for always-on sensor fusion
signals.summary: ETH Zurich's Institute of Neuroinformatics demonstrates a neuromorphic chip running a spiking neural network for multi-sensor fusion at 0.8mW, suitable for always-on edge inference in wearable and implantable devices.

signals.title: Stanford demonstrates stable silicon anode at 500 Wh/kg surviving 1,000 cycles
signals.summary: Stanford researchers report a silicon anode design using a self-healing polymer binder and nano-porous scaffold that survives 1,000 charge cycles with only 5% capacity fade at an energy density of 500 Wh/kg — nearly four times conventional lithium-ion cells.

signals.title: Graphene Flagship opens wafer-scale graphene-on-silicon pilot line at STMicroelectronics
signals.summary: The EU Graphene Flagship consortium launches a 150mm wafer pilot line at STMicroelectronics' Catania facility, enabling volume production of graphene-enhanced semiconductor devices. Initial products include photodetectors for LiDAR and sub-THz communication chips.

signals.title: TSMC ramps CoWoS-L advanced packaging to meet AI accelerator demand
signals.summary: TSMC accelerates CoWoS-L (chip-on-wafer-on-substrate with fan-out redistribution) production at its Hsinchu campus to meet demand from NVIDIA H200 and Google TPUv5 orders. Package bandwidth density increases 40% versus prior CoWoS-S, enabling larger HBM stacks.

signals.title: imec demonstrates 1.4nm-equivalent gate-all-around nanosheet on 300mm wafer
signals.summary: imec's advanced semiconductor research centre demonstrates a fully functional gate-all-around nanosheet transistor equivalent to a 1.4nm node on a production-scale 300mm wafer, using high-NA EUV patterning. The result validates the CMOS scaling roadmap to 2030.
